title: PR Hardening Loop
summary: Code review and security review run in parallel on the current change; a minimal-change engineer fixes whatever either finds, and both re-review until both pass (max 3 rounds). Best run with --backend claude-code inside the repository.

change.description: What the change is meant to do, and how to see it (e.g. 'git diff main...HEAD')

nodes.task:
Review the change: {{input.change}}

Inspect the actual diff. Report 🔴 blockers, 🟡 suggestions and 💭 nits with file:line. If fixes from a previous round are shown, verify each one.
nodes.verdict_guide: PASS = no blockers remain. FAIL = at least one blocker.

nodes.task:
Security-review the change: {{input.change}}

Inspect the actual diff for injection, authn/authz, secrets, unsafe deserialization, SSRF, dependency risk. Cite file:line and exploit scenario for each finding.
nodes.verdict_guide: PASS = no exploitable findings. FAIL = at least one finding that must be fixed.

nodes.task: Fix every blocker and security finding above with the smallest correct diff. Do not touch nits or unrelated code. Run the relevant tests and report results.
Write the PR description section 'Review & hardening': what reviewers found, what was fixed, what remains (loop status: {{nodes.rounds.status}} after {{nodes.rounds.iterations}} round(s)).
